_doc: Budgets of the building kit (public/models/kit), enforced by build-kit.mjs and tests/tools/models/buildingKit.test.ts. Every piece LOD is one primitive of the shared kit_atlas material, so a chunk that merges all kit pieces costs one draw call (plus its shadow pass); the triangle limits keep a downtown view inside the tier budgets of docs/phase-3-design.md section 10 (tier low <= 500k triangles for the whole frame): see `scenarios`. LOD distances per category live in kit.json.

scenarios._doc: Worst case views, counted with the largest piece of each group: Main Street (downtown and downtown_revival groups) with 8 buildings at LOD0, 16 at LOD1, 24 at LOD2; the harbour with 3 halls per LOD and 12 containers at LOD1. Limits are shares of the tier low frame budget (500k).
